title: Mid-apply git mv failure leaves the repo half-moved (temp-name suffix pushes a legal 248-byte basename over NAME_MAX)
notes: Crash mid-apply (File name too long on the temp name): the repo is left half-moved, with a .ac-move-0 temp file staged and unstaged edits. There is no complete output tree to certify; the partial state is the executor's crash, not a move.
